snippet.title: Team by Impact Software for the Atari STe
snippet.description:
Here is a short demonstration of Team for the Atari STe. Yes, it's a football game and yes, I normally hate sports. But, I had to play it because it's actually pretty decent. Although you might not be able to tell in this video, it's using overscan and runs at a silky smooth framerate with stereo sounds: https://ataricrypt.blogspot.com/2015/07/jumpers-for-goalposts.html

Atari ST website: https://ataricrypt.blogspot.com
Like what I do? https://www.buymeacoffee.com/AtariCrypt/ and also https://www.patreon.com/ataricrypt
